About this item

  • 【Product Dimensions】32x41x65~87(inches). Weight capacity: 660lbs (300Kg). Multi gear regulation, and the adjustable height ranges in 74.8"~87", you can adjust the height to fit your needs during workout.
  • 【Heavy-duty Construction】Featured 2mm thickens premium steel tubing with corrosion resistant, our power tower ensures maximum strength and durability for long-lasting usage. Max Load 660 lbs
  • 【Comfortable Workout】Ergonomic Design, reducing the risk of accidents and discomfort. The power tower has a stable backrest and elbow pads, which can effectively reduce body pressure and avoid sports injuries.
  • 【Multi Function】Our power tower supports a variety of upper body and strength workouts, such as pull-up, push-up, leg/knee raise and dips. Multiple handles in pull-up frame also allow you to perform more postures and exercises. Good choice for strengthening and shape your whole body.
  • 【After-sales service】 We provide assembly tools and detailed instructions. After installing all parts, tighten the screws again. Also,we suggest you can use the pull up bar on a flat concrete floor instead of carpets as there are suction cups on the bottom. If you have any questions about the product, please feel free to contact us.

    How customer reviews and ratings work

    Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

    To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

    • Oliver
      5 out of 5 stars
      Home Practical Fitness
      Reviewed in the United States on July 2, 2026
      Color: Black-02
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      If you’re on the hunt for a sturdy, multi-functional piece of home gym equipment that doesn’t take up an absurd amount of space, this free-standing pull-up and dip station is absolutely worth every penny, and I cannot recommend it highly enough. After using it consistently for three weeks, I’m blown away by its build quality, adjustability, and how many full-body workouts it unlocks right in my living room.

      First off, the construction feels incredibly heavy-duty and secure. The entire frame is thick, powder-coated steel tubing that doesn’t flex or wobble at all, even when I’m doing weighted dips or full range-of-motion pull-ups. I was initially worried free-standing bars might shift during intense sets, but the wide, curved base paired with large suction anti-slip feet eliminates any sliding or tipping risks on my hardwood floors. The triangular bracing design you can see on the product photos adds such impressive structural reinforcement—there’s zero creaking or unstable movement, even when I push my limits with core leg raises and hanging knee tucks. Safety is my top priority for home workouts, and this rig delivers total peace of mind here.

      The adjustability feature is where this product truly stands out from cheaper competitors. The vertical posts have multiple height locking notches, so I can tweak the main pull-up bar height perfectly to match my 178cm frame, and my partner who’s much shorter can lower it easily for their training too. The integrated parallel dip bars are mounted at an ideal width, with textured non-slip grips that stop my hands from slipping mid-set, even when my palms get sweaty from long workout sessions. I also love the small backrest link accessory that attaches between the two posts; it supports my lower back during dips to cut down on strain, which has been a huge relief for my shoulders and spine compared to basic dip stations without that support.

      What I appreciate most is how versatile this single piece of gear is—no need to buy multiple separate gym machines anymore. The top multi-grip pull-up bar lets me switch between wide-grip, neutral, and close-grip pull-ups to target different back muscle groups. The lower parallel bars handle tricep dips, chest dips, and L-sit holds effortlessly. I also use it daily for hanging leg raises, oblique twists, and even stretching my hamstrings and lats post-workout. It’s a complete upper-body and core workout station compact enough to tuck against a wall when I’m not training, so it never clutters up my living space.

      Assembly was surprisingly straightforward as well. All pre-drilled holes lined up perfectly, every bolt and Allen wrench tool needed came included in the package, and the step-by-step instruction diagrams were clear and easy to follow. I put the whole unit together by myself in under 40 minutes without any confusing misalignment or missing parts. The matte pearlescent surface finish resists smudges and minor scuffs, so it still looks sleek and brand new after weeks of regular heavy use—no cheap flaking paint like I’ve seen on budget fitness equipment before.

      For context, I previously considered expensive wall-mounted pull-up bars, but renting means I can’t drill into walls, making this free-standing design the perfect workaround. It’s stable enough for intense strength training yet portable if I ever want to move it to another room. The ergonomic grip padding on every bar is thick and soft on my palms, preventing blisters even during marathon workout sessions, a small detail that makes a massive difference in comfort over time.

      If you want to build serious upper-body strength at home without splurging on a full home gym setup, this pull-up dip station is an unbeatable investment. It’s robust, adaptable, space-efficient, and built to withstand years of consistent training. I’ve already noticed massive improvements in my back, chest, triceps, and core strength since adding this to my routine, and I no longer waste money on monthly gym memberships. 10/10, five stars without hesitation—this is easily the best home fitness purchase I’ve made all year!

      I wanted a piece of equipment for basic strength training at home during the winter. I previously bought a pull-up bar that mounted in the door frame, but it always made creaking noises when I used it, and I was worried about falling.

      I chose this tower pull up bar primarily for its solid construction. It was well-packaged with no damage upon arrival; the materials and build quality are excellent. The tubing thickness feels right, indicating good quality. Every screw and nut was labeled and the holes lined up perfectly, allowing me to complete the assembly by myself in about half an hour by following the instructions.

      Once assembled, it is extremely stable. The flared base, combined with the reinforced, thickened frame design, makes pull-ups very solid with no wobbling. I performed various exercises, and the tower did not shake. I can do leg raises, crunches, and push-ups. The base even has handle-like grips for push-ups. It fully meets my home workout needs and is a fantastic piece of home fitness equipment.

      My next plan is to purchase a TRX GO Suspension Trainer System to combine with this for exercising more parts of my body.
